title: Rate Card Note — Volume Steps on the Support Hour Rate of a Building Automation Service Plan
content:
# Rate Card Note — Volume Steps on the Support Hour Rate of a Building Automation Service Plan

**The step.** On a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans, where the hours logged against resolved tickets in the twelve months to the handling day are at least three times the included support hours standing to the plan's credit and at least three of those tickets were closed on site, the remote hours carry the tier's support hour rate less twelve per cent. Where those hours are at least twice and less than three times the included support hours standing to the plan's credit and at least one of those tickets was closed on site, the remote hours carry the tier's support hour rate less six per cent. In every other case the remote hours carry the tier's support hour rate. The stepped rate is taken to two decimal places.

| Hours logged in the twelve months, against the included support hours standing to the plan's credit | Tickets closed on site in those twelve months | Rate the remote hours carry |
|---|---|---|
| at least three times them | at least 3 | the tier's support hour rate less 12 per cent |
| at least twice and less than three times them | at least 1 | the tier's support hour rate less 6 per cent |
| any other combination | any | the tier's support hour rate |

## Points of judgement

- Both parts of a step must hold together. Hours at four times the included hours with only 2 tickets closed on site do not reach the twelve per cent step; they are tested against the second row, and since 4 times is not less than three times, neither step applies and the tier's support hour rate stands.
- Hours at exactly three times the included hours with 3 tickets closed on site reach the twelve per cent step, the boundary being at least three times. Hours at exactly twice the included hours with 1 ticket closed on site reach the six per cent step.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A plan with 8 hours standing to its credit shows 26 hours logged against resolved tickets in the twelve months and 3 of those tickets closed on site. Since 26 hours is at least three times 8 hours and at least 3 tickets were closed on site, the remote hours carry a support hour rate of 162 USD less 12 per cent, that is 142.56 USD an hour.
